title: Who Posts About Local Politics? Municipal Council Discussions on the Forum Platform Stadtgespräch, 2019–2023
redact: University of Nowhere, Department of Communication

primary_aim.text: Describe who posts about municipal council politics on a regional forum platform: how concentrated posting is, how it follows council meetings, and how common uncivil posts are.

secondary_aims.text: Introduce a reusable pipeline for collecting forum data.
